title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-06-08

ai_review.summary: Stunning stereo soundboard capture of a psychedelic Fillmore West night, highlighted by a smoking Lovelight > The Things I Used To Do > Who's Lovin' You Tonight run.
ai_review.review: The recording is a high‑fidelity stereo soundboard mix that delivers crystal‑clear instrument separation and an excellent overall balance. The show itself is hailed as a peak psychedelic experience, with the Lovelight sequence and first‑set gems like He Was a Friend of Mine, China Cat Sunflower and New Potato Caboose receiving special praise.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (mostly 4‑5 stars) for both performance and audio quality, with multiple specific compliments and no substantive criticisms.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stereo soundboard source; crisp, balanced mix with clear instrument definition. No reported drop‑outs or muddiness.

standout_songs: Lovelight > The Things I Used To Do > Who's Lovin' You Tonight
He Was a Friend of Mine > China Cat Sunflower > New Potato Caboose
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds strong momentum with blues‑rock numbers; the second set centerpiece (Lovelight sequence) drives the psychedelic peak, creating an exemplary excursion.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar tone described as perfect and central to the psychedelic moments.
band_member_comments.Phil: Multiple reviewers note Phil’s LSD‑enhanced bass work as a peak of his creative output.
